@graph.rdfs:label: Physical Reality Certificate (PRC)
@graph.rdfs:comment: A deterministic, cryptographically anchored record of the physical state of a Real-World Asset, generated by a Prop Trust Certified Expert (PTCE).

@graph.rdfs:label: PRRB Rating
@graph.rdfs:comment: Prop Trust Risk Rating (AAA to F) based on 5 forensic vectors (Registry, Structural, Cash-flow, Encumbrance, Telemetry).

@graph.rdfs:label: QFER Hash
@graph.rdfs:comment: SHA-256 or Keccak-256 hash of the Qualified Forensic Evidence Record (PDF/A-3).

@graph.rdfs:label: eIDAS 2.0 QES Validated
@graph.rdfs:comment: Boolean indicating if the record is signed with a valid eIDAS 2.0 Qualified Electronic Signature.

@graph.rdfs:label: LO-PR Registry Anchor
@graph.rdfs:comment: Transaction hash of the immutable Layer 0 Physical Reality ledger anchor (must be ≤ 72h post-signature).

@graph.rdfs:label: Circuit Breaker Status
@graph.rdfs:comment: Current operational state of the asset's secondary market transferability based on APRIS parametric triggers.
